content.short: De.Fi is the inventor of crypto's first antivirus and the Web3 Super App.
content.description: De.Fi positions itself as the creator of crypto's first antivirus and offers a Web3 Super App for the DeFi ecosystem. It bundles a Web3 Super App with an APY aggregator, delivering a unified dashboard that supports 42+ blockchains, 265+ protocols, and 8+ exchanges. This enables users to monitor multi-chain assets and positions across the ecosystem. The APY aggregator provides historical APR and TVL data for more than 10,000 liquidity pools and vaults across 300+ protocols.
